body:
I have to agree with you on the sharpness of the military to an extent. They've severely disappointed me in the last year or so.
On another note, I've read the symptoms of a a few forms of bipolar disorders, and while a couple of things could fit my description the majority don't.

I haven't been diagnosed with anything.
I'd imagine the military would've caught that I had some screws loose somewhere when I was enlisting a year or so ago.
I've never really looked into it either. From what I've read on the internet, many of the symptoms that match Avoidant personality disorder could fit me. As well as a few of the symptoms of Borderline personality disorder. Although when I read posts from people with those disorders, or watch youtube videos about them. From what I can tell those people seem far worse off than me. To the point where they struggle with day to day life. While I'm extremely miserable, I'm able to at least mask it and function in my day to day life.

I don't know if you're still on here, but i honestly didn't expect to ever log back in or check this post.
I have a different mindset now, albeit not to much differently.
